content:
## Overview

Firecrawl for Platforms lets your platform create and manage Firecrawl API keys for your users directly from your own backend. Your users can then search, scrape, and interact with the web through Firecrawl, the context API for AI agents, without leaving your platform.

Set up Firecrawl for Platforms yourself in the [Firecrawl dashboard](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api). Any admin or member of an organization can create an integration: name it, choose an integration type, accept the agreement for that type, and copy the platform key. The key is shown once. You can mint and revoke keys later under Settings. No application or approval is needed.

There are two integration types. Both provision accounts the same way through the endpoints below, with the same platform key; they differ in who pays for the user’s usage:

- **Standard**: your users pay Firecrawl. Each provisioned account keeps its own Firecrawl plan and billing and upgrades with Firecrawl directly. See Credits for provisioned accounts for what a new account starts with.
- **Gateway**: your organization funds your users. Accounts your integration creates are enrolled in Gateway, so their eligible usage bills to your organization. See Gateway below.

You choose the integration type when you create the integration. It is not easy to change afterwards, so we recommend reviewing both options carefully before you accept the agreement. See the [Firecrawl for Platforms page](https://www.firecrawl.dev/firecrawl-for-platforms) for an overview. Some partner offers include promotional credits for provisioned users; when they do, [Partner Credits](/partner-credits) describes what the user receives.

### Gateway

Gateway is an integration type, not a separate API. The same platform key and the same endpoints apply. What changes for a Gateway integration:

- Accounts are created for your integration alone and are API-only, with no dashboard login of their own. A request never attaches to an existing Firecrawl account, even when the email matches one.
- Eligible usage bills to your organization. See Credits for provisioned accounts for when a user’s own credits are used first.
- Responses from `POST /partner/v1/accounts` carry a `gatewayStatus` field.
- The integration accepts the Gateway version of the agreement when it is created.

## Base URL

```
https://integrations.firecrawl.dev
```

## Authentication

All Platforms API requests require an `Authorization` header with your platform key:

```
Authorization: Bearer <platform key>
```

Platform keys are distinct from standard Firecrawl API keys. You create and revoke them under Settings > Firecrawl for Platforms in the [Firecrawl dashboard](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api).

## Security Requirements

- **Server-side only**: Platform keys must only be used in server-side code. Never expose a platform key in frontend code, client-side JavaScript, or mobile applications.
- **Terms of Service**: Before calling `POST /partner/v1/accounts`, your platform must prompt the user to accept Firecrawl’s [Terms of Service](https://www.firecrawl.dev/terms-of-service).

## Before you are verified

You can create an integration and provision accounts right away, with no application, so you can build and test your integration today. Until Firecrawl verifies your platform:

- **Volume is limited.** The number of accounts your integration can create is limited. That is enough to build and test, not to roll out to all your users.
- **Accounts carry no free credits.** See Credits for provisioned accounts.

Every `POST /partner/v1/accounts` response carries a `notice` with the code `partner_unverified` while your platform is unverified, and the Firecrawl for Platforms page in the dashboard shows the same status.

### Request verification

Add a card to your organization on the [Firecrawl for Platforms page](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api) in the dashboard to verify your integration. Verification is automatic once the card is on file, and a card can verify only one organization. For a signed agreement or higher volume, write to [partnerships@firecrawl.dev](mailto:partnerships@firecrawl.dev) with your integration ID and the volume you expect.

### What verification unlocks

- Account limits that fit the volume you expect.
- The Free plan’s monthly credits on new and existing accounts. For Gateway accounts those are used before your organization is billed.

### The limit error

When an unverified integration reaches its limit, `POST /partner/v1/accounts` returns `403` and creates no account:

```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "partner_account_cap_reached",
    "message": "This integration isn't verified yet, so the number of accounts it can create is limited. Add a card in the Firecrawl dashboard (https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api) to verify it, or email partnerships@firecrawl.dev with your integration ID <integration ID> and the volume you expect. See https://docs.firecrawl.dev/firecrawl-for-platforms#before-you-are-verified"
  }
}
```

Accounts you have already created keep working, and a repeated call for a user you have already provisioned still returns that account.

## Credits for provisioned accounts

Accounts your integration creates do not carry free credits unless Firecrawl has verified your platform or you have a signed agreement with Firecrawl. Until then:

- A **Standard** account starts without included credits. The user can add a payment method or pick a plan in the Firecrawl dashboard at any time.
- A **Gateway** account bills every credit to your organization.

Once your platform is verified, new and existing accounts carry the Free plan’s monthly credits; for Gateway accounts those are used before your organization is billed. See Request verification. When a Gateway account runs out of credits, its requests to the Firecrawl API return `402` with the code `platform_managed_credits` and a message that tells your user to contact your platform.

## Limits

Account creation is limited per integration, both in how many accounts an integration can create and in how fast. The limits grow with your organization’s relationship with Firecrawl and never affect accounts you have already created. A repeated call for a user you have already provisioned returns the existing account and does not count toward the account limit. The address you send for a Standard account has to be one your user can receive mail at. Until your platform is verified, volume is limited; see Before you are verified. If you reach a limit, or you are planning a production integration, write to [partnerships@firecrawl.dev](mailto:partnerships@firecrawl.dev) with your integration ID and the volume you expect. If Firecrawl suspends your integration, write to [help@firecrawl.com](mailto:help@firecrawl.com).

---

## Endpoints

### Create user

Provisions a Firecrawl account for one of your users, identified by email, and returns its API key.

```
POST /partner/v1/accounts
```

#### Behavior

With a **Standard** integration:

- If the user does not yet have a Firecrawl account, a new user and team are created.
- If the user already has a Firecrawl account but no team associated with your integration, a new team associated with your integration is created.
- If the user already has a Firecrawl account and a team associated with your integration, the existing team is returned.

With a **Gateway** integration:

- Every account is created for your integration alone. A request never attaches to an existing Firecrawl account, even when the email matches one. The email is stored as the account’s contact address and is not used to look accounts up.
- Repeated calls for the same email return the same account and its API key.

If your integration includes promotional credits, they are applied once, when the account is first created.

#### Request

cURL

```
curl -X POST "https://integrations.firecrawl.dev/partner/v1/accounts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <platform key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "user@example.com"}'
```

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | Yes | The user’s email address. For a Gateway integration it is stored as the account’s contact address. |

#### Response

**`200 OK`**

```
{
  "apiKey": "fc-...",
  "alreadyExisted": false
}
```

For a Gateway integration the response also carries the enrollment status:

```
{
  "apiKey": "fc-...",
  "alreadyExisted": false,
  "gatewayStatus": "enrolled"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | The Firecrawl API key for the team your integration provisioned for this user |
| `alreadyExisted` | boolean | `true` if your integration had already provisioned an account for this email. It says nothing about whether the email exists elsewhere in Firecrawl. |
| `gatewayStatus` | string | Gateway integrations only. `enrolled` on the call that creates the account, `already_enrolled` on repeated calls for the same email. |
| `notice` | object | Present while your platform is not verified. `code` is `partner_unverified`, `message` explains what is limited and how to request verification, `integrationId` is your integration ID and `docsUrl` links to Before you are verified. |

#### Errors

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `400` | Bad request - `email` is missing or malformed |
| `401` | Unauthorized - the platform key is incorrect or invalid |
| `403` | Refused - the body’s `error.code` says why: `partner_account_cap_reached` (the integration is at its account limit; see The limit error), `partner_provisioning_email_rejected` (the address cannot be used for a Firecrawl account) or `partner_integration_suspended`. See Limits |
| `429` | Too many requests - `rate_limit_exceeded`; slow down and retry |
| `502` | Firecrawl could not reach its billing provider while setting the account up - retry the request |
| `503` | Firecrawl could not check the rate limit - retry shortly |
| `500` | Internal server error - these errors are monitored by Firecrawl |

---

### Validate API Key

Validates a Firecrawl API key and returns the associated team name and user email address. The API key will only return as valid if it was created through your integration.

```
POST /partner/v1/api-keys/validate
```

#### Important Notes

- Firecrawl API keys do not have permissions or an expiry date.
- API keys can be manually deleted by users at any time.
- Deleted API keys are not soft-deleted. Firecrawl cannot distinguish a deleted key from one that never existed.

#### Request

cURL

```
curl -X POST "https://integrations.firecrawl.dev/partner/v1/api-keys/validate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <platform key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"apiKey": "fc-..."}'
```

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | The API key to validate |

#### Response

**`200 OK`**

```
{
  "teamName": "Example Team",
  "email": "user@example.com"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `teamName` | string | The name of the team associated with this API key |
| `email` | string | The email the account was provisioned with. For Gateway accounts this is the contact address you supplied. |

#### Errors

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `400` | Bad request - the API key is malformed |
| `401` | Unauthorized - the platform key is incorrect or invalid |
| `404` | API key not identifiable - the key does not exist or was not created through your integration |
| `500` | Internal server error - these errors are monitored by Firecrawl |

---

### Rotate API Key

Deletes an existing Firecrawl API key and creates a new one for the same user and team.

```
POST /partner/v1/api-keys/rotate
```

#### Request

cURL

```
curl -X POST "https://integrations.firecrawl.dev/partner/v1/api-keys/rotate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <platform key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"apiKey": "fc-..."}'
```

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | The API key to delete and replace |

#### Response

**`200 OK`**

```
{
  "apiKey": "fc-..."
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | The newly created API key |

#### Errors

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `401` | Unauthorized - the platform key is incorrect or invalid |
| `404` | API key not identifiable - the key does not exist or was not created through your integration |
| `500` | Internal server error - these errors are monitored by Firecrawl |

---

## Get Started

Create your integration in the [Firecrawl dashboard](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/partner-api): sign in, choose Standard or Gateway, accept the agreement, and copy your platform key. The integration type is not easy to change afterwards, so please confirm your choice before accepting the agreement. Then call the endpoints above from your server. Questions about your setup? Write to [help@firecrawl.com](mailto:help@firecrawl.com). A larger integration in mind? Write to [partnerships@firecrawl.dev](mailto:partnerships@firecrawl.dev).

## Partner program

Platforms that provision Firecrawl accounts for their users can apply to the Firecrawl Partner Program. Approved partners get a revenue share on paid usage from the users they bring, co-marketing and a listing in our partner directory, early access to new endpoints, a direct line to our team for technical support, and higher limits for their users. Apply and we email you next steps right away: create your integration in the dashboard and add a card to verify it. In return, partners display “Powered by Firecrawl” in their product, linking to firecrawl.dev with their `?ref=<partner>` tag. Rev share applies only to new paying customers you refer after your application is approved, never retroactively. Every partner is reviewed and approved by our team. [Apply to the Partner Program](https://www.firecrawl.dev/firecrawl-for-platforms/partner-program?source=docs) Writing about Firecrawl or linking to it? The [affiliate program](https://www.firecrawl.dev/affiliates) fits better.
